method: Matched Builder confirmation descriptive case audit; each range/build covers the same eight cells and two four-game quartets per cell. Ratios use unmodified existing pooled counts. Five-foul timing was not archived, so its causal contribution to lost minutes remains unresolved. Unarchived on-court opponent counters are omitted, never filled with observed zero.
representative_fields: ratings/body/tendencies and raw_ovr are from first retained row cell0/quartet0/phase0; vector counts/ranges expose differing source caps and legal allocations in other matched cells.
unavailable: opponent FGA/FGM while player on court

natural_college_selected_inversion.interpretation: Four-game descriptive same-team comparison with the same position/tactical/rotation role and tendencies, different age/body/prospect/starting resource and live opportunity. Individual causal attribution remains unresolved; not an equal-resource fairness comparison.
